notes.title: An Episode 1 Upgrade!
notes.content:
A new update has been released to Rivalhearts!

Changes include:

[list]
[*] [b]Created a new opening scene to Episode 1[/b]
[*] [b]Added a new section to Erika's check-up in Episode 1[/b]
[*] [b]Added a new guessing game to Amber's introduction in Episode 1[/b]
[*] [b]Introduced blooper voice lines to Rivaldarts[/b] (only in the new opening scene for now)
[*] Moved the old Episode 1 opening scene to a later section in the episode
[*] Changed Katherine's profile picture on the Episode 1 phone to one of herself
[*] Changed Rivaldarts names to now be able to change per-dialogue if multiple names available
[*] Changed game archive files to now include source (RPY) script files
[*] Tweaked some of Noah's dialogue at the start of Episode 1 to better fit the new opening scene
[*] Tweaked some of Noah and Erika's dialogue together in Episode 1
[/list]
As episode 2 comes closer to completion, we wanted to upgrade episode 1 based on feedback and hindsight! Episode 1 is the first experience a player has of Rivalhearts, so it's important for it to be as good as it can be; and we think we're nearing that mark now.

For more information, please join [url=https://discord.gg/S8V8xaJFJs]The Rivalhearts Discord[/url]. 
Thanks for reading!

notes.title: The Spanish Translation and Sounds Galore Update!
notes.content:
A new update has been released to Rivalhearts!

Changes include:

[list]
[*] Added a complete Spanish translation of the game (Thanks, FumoFumoEnjoyer!)
[*] Added many new sound effects to the first episode

[list]
[*] Amber's cute expression changes? Now with extra effects!
[*] Noah's mind during Erika's check-up? A rollercoaster of sounds!
[*] Brooklyn's tummy? It now rumbles!
[*] Katherine's fiery personality? Fully realized! [/list]
[*] Added the ability to hide the UI while in an episode by right-clicking
[*] Added the ability to change episodes with the < and > keys (comma & period)
[*] Added Steam Timeline support officially and improved upon it
[*] Added Steam Remote Play on TV officially after being tested
[*] Added the game detecting if a player is on an older version and notifying if so
[*] Added an official "Playable" status for Steam Deck (Thanks, Valve!)
[*] Optimized game further for Steam Deck
[*] Improved the user interface
[*] Fixed Rivaldarts text appearing without an outline
[*] Changed the first scene's text in episode one to be less slow
[*] Changed text pauses to be a little faster
[*] Tweaked some dialogue
[/list]
That's all for now, folks. [url=https://discord.gg/S8V8xaJFJs]The Rivalhearts Discord[/url] has extra progress updates and other news.
Thanks for reading!

notes.title: Rivalhearts Minor Update Released
notes.content:
A minor update has been released to Rivalhearts!

Changes include:

[list]
[*] Added an extensive custom text speed option
[*] Added the ability to load a save while in an episode
[*] Updated "Achieved..." notification flavor text to be more accurate to each girl's level of interest
[*] Updated some DevBox text
[*] Updated the Settings screen
[*] Fixed a crash bug in Rivaldarts
[/list]
That's all for now, folks. Thanks for reading!
